title: Fix release installation with inaccessible PATH entries and clarify macOS/Codex setup
scope: Fix the reproduced release-installer EACCES failure caused by an unrelated inaccessible PATH entry; add focused regression coverage; verify first install and command/MCP launch from a fresh supported shell without pre-seeding the command directory; clarify published macOS installation, permission failure handling, stable installed locations and Codex MCP registration in primary and packaged instructions. Preserve unrelated commands/data and explicit user-controlled client configuration. Do not claim the reported real-Mac incident is reproduced without its exact command/stderr; do not bypass sandbox or Gatekeeper restrictions, add project-local installation fallbacks, automatic client configuration or new CLI commands.
acceptance: The actual release installer succeeds with a non-searchable unrelated PATH directory, and still refuses an accessible unrelated tasks command; a regression test fails against the original installer.

A native macOS archive acceptance starts with a fresh zsh HOME and PATH without the installed bin directory, runs the documented installer, discovers the installed tasks command in a new login shell and starts MCP by command name; Linux/Windows acceptance remains valid.

Primary and packaged macOS instructions distinguish extraction, successful installation and MCP registration; include supported failure remediation and the official Codex command codex mcp add tasks -- tasks mcp, client restart/verification and a documented installed-path/Node alternative when client PATH differs.
Independent review, focused QA and required local checks pass on the combined candidate; record concrete evidence and any still-unobserved real-Mac/Codex boundaries before candidate closure.

Include advancing stable version/lockfile and exact release notes under the project release value gate. Native hosted CI/archive gates require explicit remote-action agreement. Publication and downloaded-asset checks are read-only post-merge acceptance, never pre-merge claims.

values.goal: Support reliable per-user installation and local CLI/MCP use on the declared platforms.
values.value: Users can install the release despite an unrelated inaccessible PATH entry and follow clear macOS/Codex setup instructions instead of an accidental project-local workaround.
values.observable_result: The reproduced installer failure is eliminated and a clean-shell installed-command/MCP scenario works at the user boundary.
values.verification: Run the regression against original/fixed installer, native distribution acceptance with a fresh shell PATH, and inspect the actual packaged instructions.

notes:

Prior native CI preseeded PATH and used Bash plus direct SDK MCP launch. No changes to published v1.0 assets.
